No.: LC-9(2015)Review of Legal Dash Board <i Dated: 10.09.2015

All Additional Central PF Commissioner 11 SEP
(Zones) ~ 2015

Subject:- 100% Data Entry in Legal Dash Board-Regarding.

Reference:-Head Office Letter No. LC-9(2015)Review of Legal Dash

Board/22178 dated 24-08-2015.

Sir,

Please refer to above subject and reference, while doing the test
check by Head Office, it has been observed that the 100% data entry in Legal
Dash Board has not been made by many offices in spite of the certificates to this
effect given by all Additional Central Provident Fund Commissioner(Zones).
Due to incomplete data entry in Legal Dash Board , the correct report can not
be extracted.

a. For example, the report on age wise pendency can not be
extracted unless date of filing of case is filled up . It is found that there are
large number of cases where date of filing the case has not been entered by the
field offices in Legal Dash Board..

3. It is requested to make the entry for date of filing the case in Legal
Dash Board, which is secipeamsial

4. Therefore , you are requested to ensure that the offices under your
jurisdiction must make the required entry on Legal Dash Board.

Yours faithfully,

M.P. Varghese)
Addl. Central P.F. Commissioner -I (Legal)
